summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting full-year FY26 results for the period ended March 2026. The filing is an ordinary earnings release, disclosing a 40% rise in pre-exceptional profit to €2.26bn, traffic growth to 208.4m passengers, and a proposed final dividend of €0.195 per share subject to AGM approval. There is no transaction, strategic review, or special situation. The report includes routine operational and financial updates, fleet plans, and a share buyback program. This is a periodic financial disclosure, not a special-situation event.
